notes.title: Recap: After Releasing Sticker Delight Last Month 🥁
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
We hope you're all doing well! ✨
We're excited to bring you some updates, after releasing Sticker Delight last month!

(1) Sticker Delight has been reviewed "Positive"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/e1529d138a35d36ca9614b24e7c81fb65020a842.jpg
What can we say except thank you! It’s all thanks to awesome people like you who trust Sticker Delight, play it, and share your thoughts in reviews. We read every single one, and they mean the world to us! Nothing makes us happier than seeing you enjoy cozy, nostalgic moments with Sticker Delight. We’re always looking for ways to make the game even better, so keep those reviews coming!

We just love reading your feedback—so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts after playing! 😊

(2) Sticker Delight started to make appearances 
We were thrilled to see Sticker Delight made appearances across Southeast Asia's media, as well as within indie & cozy game communities on various platforms. Check out the coverage here:

 SEA Game Dev Collective Digest - September Edition
 VirtualSEA - on both their website and Youtube Channel
 The Magic Rain - Here’s Every SEA Game Awards Finalist From Level Up KL 2024
 Livestream by nuryEm on Twitch (and their craft made on stream) 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/7025a5be202fe43929533c812338366bc2da09a8.png
 South East Asia Game Aesthetic

A big thank you to each community for the support and for helping share Sticker Delight with the world!

(3) Sticker Delight showcase at Level Up KL 2024
Sticker Delight was featured in the SEA Game Award Finalists 2024 zone at Level Up KL on October 2-3, 2024. We loved seeing visitors enjoy playing and crafting with the stickers, with some even purchasing the game on the spot!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/d0c66ccc7ed2fbf5e992a69e29f633f660ad7274.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/29270b88694414c4f694807432e0bad5d63fd1c8.jpg

(4) Sticker Delight's next update
After reading your reviews and watching players enjoy Sticker Delight, we're excited to share a sneak peek of what's coming next!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/46faea831b0740b6271632188cb623ffbaebf04f.jpg

 We're currently working on an update to enhance the Sticker Book, which will allow you to resize and rotate the stickers.
 Also, we're going to add Steam Achievements.

Stay tuned for the updates!

(5) Dawn Sky's newsletter sign up
We want to stay connected with players who love Sticker Delight. Working on and releasing Sticker Delight has given us the confidence that there are players out there (like you!) who appreciate games that fit into your lives.

If you love Sticker Delight and would like to receive special updates straight to your inbox, please sign up for our newsletter using this link. 



Now back to the game,
Li
Producer - Sticker Delight
Dawn Sky's Socials

notes.title: Sticker Delight Update #3: Introducing Sticker Book in The Game
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have two exciting updates to share this time! ✨

Introducing: Sticker Book Feature
We have finally finished developing a delightful new feature for the game: the Sticker Book. You will be able to access the Sticker Book after completing dinner for the first time. Inside the Sticker Book, you can:

 Reminisce about the memories by keeping photos taken during dinner
 Choose and keep your favorite stickers from the pack
 Express yourself using stickers from the pack and text stickers that you create (we've also included a screenshot and download button, so you can share it with your loved ones)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/4aeb991592017a8cd4766767b4408c62167bb12c.gif

While this might not be obvious, we also believe that the Sticker Book is a versatile tool that you can keep coming back to in the future to express your thoughts to loved ones!
It works like this: Open the Sticker Book → express your thoughts → screenshot and download → share it to your loved ones → repeat

Sticker Delight is Nominated as SEA Game Awards 2024 Finalist! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/9a09554312d218d5a15ea9b9441ec2bde738efe6.png
Earlier this month, we received an announcement that Sticker Delight has been nominated for the SEA Game Awards 2024 (public announcement here)! The final results will be announced on October 2, and we're sharing this joy to spread positive energy to everyone following our news 😊

I'll catch you in the next post,
Li
Producer - Sticker Delight

notes.title: Sticker Delight Update #2: How Sticker Delight Started (a Devlog)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Welcome back! This time, I've brought along my fellow team members and we'll be sharing some stories behind Sticker Delight.

How did Sticker Delight start?
Earlier this year, I (Li) pitched a wholesome game idea about bringing players to reminisce childhood, revolving around stickers and food.
 
Once pre-production wrapped up, the game idea really took shape: play as a child who completes errands to prepare a New Year's dinner for family and friends.

Fast forward to now, we're on our way to finishing Sticker Delight soon. Time really flies.

Who's developing Sticker Delight?
We're making Sticker Delight with following team:
- I (Li) am in charge of producing and design,
- Riady is in charge of programming, 
- Cc is in charge of art

What did we explore in the beginning?
Design
Li: As far as I remember, the first thing I explored was sticker puzzles. I asked myself, "How Might We use stickers to progress in the game?"

I played around with stickers and ended up designing multiple sticker puzzles. 
Here's the evolution of one of our sticker puzzles:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/f7739758edce1622061897690948cf5216684dae.png

Art
Cc: My first step was to create the visual foundation for the game. I started by creating a mood board to capture the cozy and inviting atmosphere we wanted to convey. I led the team to brainstorm together for making the mood board. 

Using that mood board as inspiration, I experimented with different art styles to find the perfect match for our game. It was a fun process exploring various looks until we finally found a style that could represent everything we wanted to convey in this game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077900/c9d389c89e239e31377818329154acd414a2ed5f.gif

Tech
Riady: Since the core mechanic we wanted in this game was dragging and dropping objects under certain rule, such as "the sticker must cover X area" or "the sticker must be within X area," the first thing I did was create a simple gameplay prototype to cover those aspects. Initially, I struggled with the "sticker must cover X area" mechanic. I thought I needed a complex math formula to calculate the surface area considered "covered" by other objects. However, after some thought, I found a better solution by using many small colliders within the image. When the player drops the object, it checks each individual small collider. If all the colliders are checked, then the object is considered "covered."

***
That's it for today's update! 
Catch you in the next post,

Li
Producer - Sticker Delight
